content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the AIIMS Bhopal Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Research Scientist I (Medical) and 1 for Project Technical Support - II.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Medical): MBBS/ BDS. Experience of Working in Clinical Biochemistry and Pathology Laboratory with knowledge of NABL requirements as per ISO 15189:2022. Project Technical Support - II: 12th in Science, Diploma (MLT/ DMLT/ Engineering) with Five Years Experience in relevant subject/ field of the project. Experience of Working in Clinical Biochemistry and Pathology laboratory and Assisting in conducting, monitoring and co-ordinating activities.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Medical): Maximum Age Limit: 35 years. Project Technical Support - II: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I: Rs. 67000+20 % HRA=Rs 80400/ - p.m. Project Technical Support II: For 1st year Rs 20000 + 20%HRA: 24000x12: 2,88,000.00. For 2nd Year = 2,88,000.00. For the 3rd year: 2,88,000.00 + (1000 x 12 ) : 3,00,000.00.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Interview for the post of Project Research Scientist I (Medical). Written test followed by skill test and interview by the competent selection panel for the post of Project Technical Support II.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhopal Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) and Project Technical Support-II posts at AIIMS Bhopal is scheduled for 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post?
faq.answer: For the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) position, candidates must possess an MBBS/BDS degree and have relevant experience in clinical biochemistry and pathology laboratories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support-II post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-I post?
faq.answer: The Project Research Scientist-I will receive a salary of Rs. 67000 + 20% HRA, amounting to Rs. 80400/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Technical Support-II position at AIIMS Bhopal.

faq.question: Q6. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to bring a duly filled application form, self-attested photocopies of educational and experience certificates, proof of date of birth, and original certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support-II role?
faq.answer: The selection process for Project Technical Support-II involves a written test followed by a skill test and an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal (AIIMS Bhopal).

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply offline for these positions?
faq.answer: No, these positions are for a walk-in interview, so candidates must attend the interview in person with all required documents.
